title: Retained commutative-square data
statement: CohomologySquareData retains two endomorphisms and a map between two arbitrary objects of a category, their formulas as specified maps, and their commutation law. Its explicit constructor retains supplied maps and a commutation proof. For arbitrary single-complex, coefficient inverse-image and cohomology functors with their two natural transformations, construct the retained square from a coefficient square and a specified pullback component formula.

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images, restriction of cohomology classes; Descent Tag 03DR, tensor-section restriction.

proof.text: Define the retained-square record with a category and its objects as parameters. Its explicit constructor retains the supplied maps and commutation proof and uses reflexivity for the three formula fields. Compose transformation naturality with the image of the coefficient square through the single-complex comparison, and substitute the supplied component formula. Apply the explicit square constructor. No existence theorem chooses any data.
